inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on the evidence obtained a child was left outside alone for approximately 2 minutes with no supervision.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion: A caregiver was found not to have proof of education, neither transcript or diploma.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion (26 TAC §746.1107(2))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: It was found during the inspection that the operation did not have a current Fire Inspection. The last Fire Inspection conducted was on 3/5/24.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive device for time out: It was found that a restrictive device was used for time out for a child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive device for time out (26 TAC §746.2805(8))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: It was found during the investigation that a child was not supervised at all times as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: The Fire Extinguisher used in the van had not been serviced since 2017.    This was corrected during the inspection by putting another fire extinguisher in the van.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §746.5307(b))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training: 1 out 9 records reviewed was missing 1 hour of Abuse/Neglect Training. 1 out of 9 records reviewed was missing 22 annual training hours out of 24 required annual trainings.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: 1 out of 10 records reviewed was missing a Health Statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Individual Cot, Bed, or Mat for Each Walking Child Through 4 Years of Age: It was found during the inspection that the outside material on the  nap mats being used were cracked and missing in some areas and the cushion material inside the mats were exposed therefore they were no longer waterproof.     This was corrected during the inspection by taping the areas needed in order for them to be waterproof.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Individual Cot, Bed, or Mat for Each Walking Child Through 4 Years of Age (26 TAC §746.4503(a))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: It was found during the investigation that the Director of the operation was not ensuring the operation maintain compliance with Minimum Standards by allowing classrooms to be out of ratio, not supervising employees appropriately, not ensuring the employees are maintaining compliance with Minimum Standards, and providing falsified documents to Licensing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: Evidence obtained verified that the operation had 13 or more children in care and was placing infants with children that were more than 18 months older than the youngest child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Complying with Laws and Rules: Evidence obtained supports that the Department was provided with false documentation of First Aid/CPR training certificates.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Complying with Laws and Rules (26 TAC §746.201(9))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment: Evidence obtained during the investigation found that an employee inappropriately disciplined a child by spanking the child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: It was found during the investigation that the operation did not make a report to Licensing when they became aware that a caregiver inappropriately disciplined a child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Director Qualifications - 13 or More Children: It was found during the inspection that the operation does not have a qualified Director in place and hasn't had a qualified Director in place since 1/26/2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Qualifications - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1015)

occurrences.finding: Report Change in Director: The operation did not report a change in Directors within the required timeframe.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Change in Director (26 TAC §746.303(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: It was found during the inspection that a classroom was out of ratio.    This was corrected during the inspection by calling in another caregiver to assist in this classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: The operation did not have an active background check on a caregiver and allowed the caregiver to be present in the Infant room and have access to children in care.    This was corrected during the inspection as the caregiver was sent home during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: It was found during the investigation that a child was injured due to slipping on a wet floor.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children: Based on the evidence obtained, it was found that a 2-year-old child was left alone unsupervised on the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: The operation allowed a caregiver to be present in the Toddler room and have access to children in care before receiving their eligibility letter from the Criminal Background Check Unit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: Evidence obtained during the investigation found that two infants were allowed to sleep in a bouncer for whole duration of their nap.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426)

occurrences.finding: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes: Evidence obtained during the investigation found that an infant was seated at the table with no activities provided to the infant for over 30 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes (26 TAC §746.2417(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers- Supervision of Children: Evidence obtained during this investigation found that caregivers were not supervising children appropriately.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets: It was found during the inspection that two infants were sleeping in cribs without a crib sheet on the mattress pads.    This was corrected at the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - School Information for School-age Child: 2 out 10 records reviewed was missing school information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - School Information for School-age Child (26 TAC §746.605(14))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: 2 out of 10 records reviewed didn't have current immunizations in their file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization: During the investigation, it was determined that the staff was aware of a child receiving medical attention after sustaining an injury while in care but did not report to Child Care Regulations within two days of becoming notified.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.305(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area - Able to See, Hear and Intervene: During the investigation, it was determined that the room was not set up for the caregiver to see all infants at a glance or be able to intervene in a timely manner resulting in a child being injured and needing medical attention.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area - Able to See, Hear and Intervene (26 TAC §746.2403(1))

occurrences.finding: Release of Children: It was found during the investigation that the operation released children to an unauthorized individual.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Release of Children (26 TAC §746.4101)
